project_type: Monorepo: TypeScript+Fastify (ESM) backend; Flutter/Dart app; standalone Flutter/Dart package (flutter_ring_captions)
build_system: backend: npm (Node >=20). app/package: flutter/dart. Flutter is NOT on PATH by default; install required.
test_framework: backend: vitest (test/ dir, buildTestApp + injectWS WS helpers in test/helpers). app/package: flutter_test.
build_command: backend: (cd backend && npm run build). app: (cd app && flutter build apk --release) [Android SDK needed; may not be runnable in sandbox].
test_command: backend: (cd backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test). app: (cd app && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test && dart run tool/lint_ui_copy.dart lib). package: (cd packages/flutter_ring_captions && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test).
verification_instructions: Use PATH exports: backend -> export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH (npm 11.4.2, node 22). flutter -> export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH (Flutter 3.38.10, Dart 3.10.9 — PINNED to match CI; do NOT use a newer Flutter, newer SDKs introduce spurious analyze deprecations and a Semantics test failure that are NOT real regressions). Run flutter with --no-analytics already configured. After each flutter pub get, Flutter may rewrite app/analysis_options.yaml and pubspec.lock; revert those side effects with git checkout before committing unless an intentional pubspec change is being made. Run commands as the root user (flutter prints a superuser warning but works).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. backend dist/ is gitignored build output. No golden/snapshot files.
setup_instructions: Toolchain already installed by orchestrator-side setup: Flutter 3.38.10 at /opt/flutter (git clone + checkout tag 3.38.10, bootstrapped, flutter config --no-analytics). npm available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin. Backend deps installed via (cd backend && npm ci). App/package deps via flutter pub get. If deps are missing, re-run npm ci and flutter pub get.
environment_constraints: network_mode OPEN_INTERNET (full access; package registries reachable). Flutter 3.38.10 installed and pinned to the CI version. Android SDK is NOT installed: `flutter build apk --release` (the CI android job that asserts RECORD_AUDIO/INTERNET survive R8) CANNOT be run locally. For H-2 manifest changes, make the edit correct and rely on the CI android job for the APK build/permission assertion; flutter analyze and flutter test do NOT need the Android SDK and MUST be run locally. CODEBASE_AUDIT.md lives ONLY on branch docs/aggressive-codebase-audit (not on main / not on this fix branch); its full contents are reproduced in the feature step descriptions, so the coder does not need that branch.
contribution_requirements: Atomic commits: one logical change (one finding or tightly-related cluster) per commit, NOT one giant commit. Commits MUST be authored by the user, never by Kiro: use per-commit overrides `git -c user.name="Suleiman" -c user.email="85356587+suletetes@users.noreply.github.com" commit ...`. Do NOT modify global git config. No Kiro/AI co-author trailers. No em-dashes or en-dashes anywhere (there is a UI-copy dash lint on app/lib strings and the house style forbids them in all written content/comments). Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator handles publishing). Work on branch fix/audit-findings-remediation (already created off main).
key_patterns: Backend: ESM imports use .js suffixes. Errors via domain/errors.js `errors.*()` helpers returning AppError with a code mapped to a 4xx envelope (errors.schema() => 400 code 'schema'; errors.unauthorized() => 401). Routes read request.body/query as unknown and hand-validate; NO Fastify route schemas exist today (that is M-1). HTTP session guard in app.ts requireSession checks verifySession THEN sessionInvalidation.isRevoked(claims.sub, claims.iat). WS routes authenticate via security/ws-auth.ts authenticateWs (currently sync, verifySession only, NO isRevoked). Config in config.ts via readEnv/readPositiveInt with fixture defaults; staging/demo fail-closed via assertStrongSecret. Metrics via observability/metrics.ts MetricsPort (observe for LatencyMetric incl 'webhook_ack_ms', increment for CounterMetric). Tests: test/helpers/test-app.ts buildTestApp returns {app, config, container, metrics, ...fixtures}; sessionFor(sub, secret) issues a session; WS tests use instance.injectWS and helpers in test/helpers/ws.ts (collectUntilClose, nextJson, waitFor) and pass the token via WS_SESSION_PROTOCOL_PREFIX in sec-websocket-protocol. There is a metrics-wiring.test.ts. Flutter: ports-and-adapters; production_adapters.dart binds real ports and throws DeviceBindingUnavailable where device/network is needed; app uses flutter_riverpod + shared_preferences; NO deep-link plugin in pubspec. Privacy geometry is pure math in app/lib/vision/privacy_zone_geometry.dart.
